# Grid and Pit

> Race weekend news, results and standings, with start times in ET, CT, MT and PT.

Grid and Pit is an independent, US focused news site covering Formula 1: news, the driver market, teams, results, standings, rules explainers and race times in US time zones.

Search and AI crawlers may read this site. Published articles list public sources. Cite the article URL and those sources when you rely on a story.

## Pages

- [Home](https://gridandpit.com/): Latest stories
- [Topics](https://gridandpit.com/topics/): F1 desks plus Las Vegas, Miami, Austin and Cadillac hubs
- [Newsroom](https://gridandpit.com/dashboard/): Published stories, newest first

- [News](https://gridandpit.com/topics/news/): Formula 1 news for American fans. Every story links the public source for each fact, and every time is given in US time zones.

- [Driver Market](https://gridandpit.com/topics/driver-market/): The Formula 1 driver market: confirmed seats, open seats and what teams have said on the record. Rumor is labeled as rumor and attributed.

- [Teams](https://gridandpit.com/topics/teams/): Formula 1 team news, including Cadillac, the American team. Team statements are labeled as the team's own account.

- [Results](https://gridandpit.com/topics/results/): Formula 1 race results, checked against the official classification and published with the points each driver scored.

- [Standings](https://gridandpit.com/topics/standings/): Formula 1 drivers' and constructors' standings after each round, with the source for every points total.

- [Rules Explainers](https://gridandpit.com/topics/rules/): Formula 1 rules explained in plain English: points, title scenarios, penalties and the 2026 regulations.

- [Race Times](https://gridandpit.com/topics/race-times/): Formula 1 session and race start times converted to Eastern, Central, Mountain and Pacific time, from the official timetable.

- [Archive](https://gridandpit.com/archive/): Every published story
- [F1 points table](https://gridandpit.com/data/): Drivers and constructors points with sources

- [Las Vegas Grand Prix hub](https://gridandpit.com/hubs/las-vegas/): Everything Grid and Pit has published about the Las Vegas Grand Prix on the Las Vegas Strip Circuit: schedule, start times in US time zones, and race weekend news.

- [Miami Grand Prix hub](https://gridandpit.com/hubs/miami/): Grid and Pit coverage of the Miami Grand Prix: schedule, start times in US time zones, results and race weekend news.

- [Austin and the United States Grand Prix hub](https://gridandpit.com/hubs/austin/): Grid and Pit coverage of the United States Grand Prix at the Circuit of The Americas in Austin, Texas: results, standings impact and team reaction.

- [Cadillac Formula 1 team hub](https://gridandpit.com/hubs/cadillac/): Grid and Pit coverage of Cadillac, the American team on the grid: race weekends, driver lineup questions and what the team has said on the record.

- [About](https://gridandpit.com/about/): Desk, sourcing rules, and corrections
- [Sources & Ethics](https://gridandpit.com/sources-ethics/): Editorial standards
- [Corrections](https://gridandpit.com/corrections/): How a factual error is corrected
- [Contact Us](https://gridandpit.com/contact/): Send a message. The thank you page is not indexed.
- [Terms of use](https://gridandpit.com/terms/): Rules for using the site
- [Privacy](https://gridandpit.com/privacy/): How the site handles information
- [Disclaimer](https://gridandpit.com/disclaimer/): Not affiliated with Formula 1; what the reporting is and is not

## Published articles



- ["Nobody wanted to be at the front": the tow game that wrecked Ferrari's Las Vegas qualifying](https://gridandpit.com/articles/2026-11-21-las-vegas-qualifying-tow-game-russell-high-risk-ferrari-both-out-q2/): Slipstream tactics decided Las Vegas qualifying. George Russell says getting the tow right was "very high-risk", while Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton both went out in Q2 and will start 11th and 12th before penalties.

- [Antonelli was fastest in Las Vegas, but a five-place penalty hands Max Verstappen his first pole on the Strip](https://gridandpit.com/articles/2026-11-21-las-vegas-gp-qualifying-antonelli-fastest-five-place-penalty-verstappen-pole/): Kimi Antonelli topped qualifying for the Las Vegas Grand Prix with a 1:33.893, but a five-place grid penalty for power unit changes drops him to sixth. Max Verstappen starts from pole alongside George Russell, with Lando Norris and Isack Hadjar on row two.

- [F1’s V8 comeback is “agreed in principle” for 2030, and the numbers say about 1,050bhp in overtake mode](https://gridandpit.com/articles/2026-11-20-f1-v8-engines-2030-agreement-in-principle-zak-brown-briatore-780bhp/): McLaren CEO Zak Brown says there is an agreement in principle for 2.1-litre V8 turbo hybrid engines from 2030. BBC Sport reports about 780bhp from the combustion engine plus a 200kW electric part, with the rules due at the World Motor Sport Council next month.

- [F1 is finally getting full-time stewards, and the FIA wants up to 15 of them](https://gridandpit.com/articles/2026-11-20-fia-full-time-f1-stewards-from-2027-12-15-department/): The FIA will start bringing full-time stewards into Formula 1 during the 2027 season, building toward a department of 12 to 15. Part-time and driver stewards will stay in a mixed roster for now.

- [Russell snatched P1 on the final lap of a soaking Las Vegas FP2, and Verstappen ended up 13th](https://gridandpit.com/articles/2026-11-20-las-vegas-fp2-russell-fastest-wet-gasly-leclerc-red-flag-verstappen-13th/): George Russell topped a wet second practice in Las Vegas with a 1:47.272 set as the chequered flag fell, 0.071s ahead of Pierre Gasly and 0.333s ahead of Charles Leclerc. A red flag for plastic debris interrupted the session.

- ["I don't even want to know my heart rate": Verstappen says no to F1's WHOOP TV plan, Leclerc says yes](https://gridandpit.com/articles/2026-11-19-verstappen-refuses-f1-whoop-heart-rate-tv-nobodys-business/): Max Verstappen says he will not take part in F1's plan to show drivers' heart rates on TV from 2027, calling it a privacy matter. Charles Leclerc is happy to share; George Russell has doubts about how fans will read the numbers.

- [Every F1 driver is getting a LEGO minifigure for the first time, and you can pre-order them now](https://gridandpit.com/articles/2026-11-19-lego-f1-all-22-drivers-minifigures-speed-champions-march-2027/): F1 and the LEGO Group have revealed a Speed Champions range with all 22 drivers as minifigures and all 11 teams' 2026 cars. Sets go on sale on 1 March 2027, with pre-orders open today in select regions.

- [Drivers' heart rates could be on your TV as early as 2027: F1 announces WHOOP partnership](https://gridandpit.com/articles/2026-11-19-f1-whoop-partnership-driver-heart-rate-tv-2027/): F1 has signed a partnership deal with wearables firm WHOOP. Drivers who sign up will wear its bands in the car, and data such as heart rate could feed TV graphics as early as 2027. F1 has not said how many drivers are in.

- ["To whom it may concern, I'm staying": Cadillac keeps Bottas for 2027, ending weeks of doubt](https://gridandpit.com/articles/2026-11-19-cadillac-confirms-bottas-2027-alongside-perez/): Cadillac has confirmed Valtteri Bottas will race for the team again in 2027 alongside Sergio Pérez. CEO Dan Towriss pointed to his experience and the value of continuity for a team still building its car.

- [Hamilton called it "the silliest thing". Now the FIA may change F1's clipping rules for 2027](https://gridandpit.com/articles/2026-11-19-fia-considers-2027-change-high-speed-deployment-clipping-hamilton/): The FIA will consult teams on how electrical power is cut back at high speed, the effect drivers call clipping, after Lewis Hamilton said it stops cars completing passes. Nothing has been agreed and the 2026 rules stay as they are.

- [Piastri set for a 10-place grid penalty at the Las Vegas GP after a fifth combustion engine](https://gridandpit.com/articles/2026-11-18-piastri-10-place-grid-penalty-las-vegas-gp-new-ice/): A reliability issue forces McLaren to fit a new internal combustion engine, taking Oscar Piastri past his allowance of four. Both McLarens also get Mercedes' ADUO turbo upgrade, which carries no penalty.

- [FIA confirms three Straight Mode zones for the Las Vegas GP, including the 1.9km Strip run](https://gridandpit.com/articles/2026-11-18-fia-three-straight-mode-zones-las-vegas-grand-prix-2026/): The longest zone runs from after Turn 12 through the Turn 13 kink to Turn 14. Overtake Mode detection is just after Turn 16, giving a chasing car within one second an extra 0.5MJ.

- [Williams will run a one-off chrome livery with Atlassian at the Las Vegas GP](https://gridandpit.com/articles/2026-11-17-williams-chrome-atlassian-livery-las-vegas-gp/): Alex Albon and Carlos Sainz will also wear matching race suits and gloves. James Vowles says the design reflects the team's near 50-year history, while Atlassian's chief executive talks up AI workflows built for the team.

- [Norris says a wet Las Vegas GP would be "scary" on Pirelli's current rain tyres](https://gridandpit.com/articles/2026-11-17-norris-verstappen-sainz-pirelli-wet-tyres-cold-las-vegas/): After the first fully wet weekend of the new rules in Sao Paulo, Lando Norris, Max Verstappen and Carlos Sainz say the intermediates lose grip when cold. Forecasts give a better than even chance of rain in Thursday's FP1.

- [Haas keep Rafael Camara for the Las Vegas GP, with Ryo Hirakawa in Bearman's car for FP1](https://gridandpit.com/articles/2026-11-16-haas-camara-las-vegas-gp-hirakawa-fp1/): The 21-year-old Brazilian gets a second F1 weekend after his wet debut in Sao Paulo. Haas have not said who partners Oliver Bearman in Qatar and Abu Dhabi, where Camara is also chasing the F2 title.

- [Wolff says Mercedes could throw their weight behind Russell in the fight for second place](https://gridandpit.com/articles/2026-11-16-wolff-mercedes-could-back-russell-for-second-in-championship/): With both titles won, Toto Wolff says Mercedes want George Russell to finish runner-up to Kimi Antonelli. Russell heads to Las Vegas third, 17 points behind Max Verstappen and one ahead of Lewis Hamilton.

- [Allison: cold tyres, not a broken car, behind Mercedes' strange handling in Brazil](https://gridandpit.com/articles/2026-11-15-allison-mercedes-brazil-tyre-temperature-explanation/): Mercedes technical director James Allison says puddles stripped the heat from fresh slicks at Interlagos and that both drivers later overworked their rear intermediates, backing deputy team principal Bradley Lord's explanation.

- [Vasseur says Ferrari knew from the first straight that the 2026 title would be hard to win](https://gridandpit.com/articles/2026-11-15-vasseur-ferrari-knew-2026-title-difficult-first-straight/): The Ferrari team principal says Mercedes were six to seven tenths faster in the opening six races and that straight-line speed held the SF-26 back, but believes Ferrari has matched the pace since Malaysia.

Only four other teams back it so far, so 2028 looks more realistic than 2027.
